# GitHub Copilot Instructions for Spec-Driven Development (Spec Kit)

This repository follows the Spec-Driven Development (SDD) lifecycle using GitHub Spec Kit.

## Available Slash Commands:
- `/speckit.constitution`: Establish or review project engineering principles and quality standards.
- `/speckit.specify`: Generate or update feature specifications and acceptance criteria.
- `/speckit.clarify`: Identify and resolve ambiguities in the specification before planning.
- `/speckit.plan`: Generate technical plan, architecture, and tech stack constraints.
- `/speckit.tasks`: Generate atomic, traceable implementation tasks.
- `/speckit.analyze`: Verify consistency and traceability across upstream and downstream artifacts.
- `/speckit.implement`: Implement approved tasks incrementally and prepare for harness validation.

Always respect the project constitution and the approved specifications before writing implementation code.
